title: Pad Thai with {p}
steps: Cook the {s} to the pack time, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the {p} in a very hot pan until {doneness}, then move to a clean plate.
Stir-fry the {v} with the {spice} for 2 minutes, add the {s} and the {sauce} and toss until coated.
Return the {p}, toss, and serve with lime and chopped peanuts.
tip: Go heavy on the veg, use half the sauce, and add lime for brightness instead of more sugar.
